pureFuturesArbitrage._venuesNote: perp DEX 'aster' and 'lighter' are also supported (scan + trade)
pureFuturesArbitrage._feeRatesNote: optional per-venue taker override (%); omit to fetch per-symbol rates from exchange APIs
pureFuturesArbitrage._riskEngineNote: risk snapshots (SAFE/WARNING/REDUCE/EMERGENCY) per open position, persisted to the ledger and shown in the dashboard
pureFuturesArbitrage._riskAutoActNote: when true, EMERGENCY state auto-closes the pair (live positions only); REDUCE always notifies for manual action
pureFuturesArbitrage._depthNote: depthCheckFailOpen=false blocks opens when the order book fetch fails (recommended for thin DEX books)
pureFuturesArbitrage._parallelLegsNote: open/close both perp legs concurrently to reduce mark_spread skew
